correctness.rationale: Inspected the exact threshold matching–ballot equivalence and reflection count, then independently implemented graph perfect-matching recursion and the symmetric Beta urn exact probability: 697 exact assertions verify the two characterizations and equal finite probabilities for even n=2..10 and three rational Beta parameters. Analytically, the reversed (n−1)-bit path has symmetric endpoint K, ballot probability E[2(K+1)/(n+K+1)*1_{K>0}], variance σ²=L+L(L−1)/(κ+1), and difference from E|K|/n bounded by O(n^{-1}+σ²/n²). The Beta mixing CLT and conditional centered-binomial CLT are asymptotically independent; every coefficient subsequence converges to a unit Gaussian combination, proving K/σ→N(0,1) for every κ_n→∞. Uniform integrability from exact second moment gives E|K|/σ→sqrt(2/π), and σ/n∼sqrt(1/n+1/κ). Finite enumeration corroborates, but the rate-free asymptotic comes from this analytic proof.
